label.zh-TW: ShopBack 邀請好友賺獎勵金（官方條款）

title.zh-TW: 邀請頁顯示 NT$50 邀請獎勵金
title.en: The invite page shows an NT$50 invite reward

text.zh-TW: 取自邀請頁的顯示文字（金額在頁面上，條款沒有另列）；要完成成功邀請的條件才會轉為已確認，實際以官方頁面為準。
text.en: From the invite page text (the terms list no amount); it turns confirmed only after the invitation conditions are met. The official page prevails.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結，並依指示註冊 ShopBack 帳號。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link and register a ShopBack account.

steps.zh-TW: 透過 ShopBack 到合作商家完成累積消費金額 $800 元以上的訂單。
steps.en: Complete orders totalling $800 or more at partner merchants through ShopBack.

steps.zh-TW: 等現金回饋狀態轉為「已確認」，並更新銀行帳戶提領資訊。
steps.en: Wait until the cash back status becomes “Confirmed”, and update your bank account details for withdrawals.

intro.zh-TW: 透過 ShopBack 到合作商家消費可獲得現金回饋；使用邀請連結註冊，符合條件時你與好友都能獲得推薦獎勵金。
intro.en: Earn cash back at partner merchants through ShopBack; sign up with the invite link and both you and your friend can get a referral reward.

description.zh-TW:
ShopBack 是現金回饋平台：先透過它前往合作商家消費，符合條件的訂單可獲得現金回饋。本站的邀請連結不含邀請碼，不必輸入代碼，直接點擊連結註冊即可。

邀請頁會顯示邀請人送你 NT$50 邀請獎勵金。依官方條款，好友須在註冊日起 180 天內完成：用邀請連結、邀請碼或電子信箱註冊；透過 ShopBack 在合作商家累積消費 $800 元以上的訂單；該訂單的現金回饋轉為「已確認」；更新銀行帳戶提領資訊。全部達成才算成功邀請，否則推薦獎勵會變成「被拒絕」；實際條件與金額以 ShopBack 官方公告為準。
description.en:
ShopBack is a cash back service: you shop at partner merchants through ShopBack, and qualifying orders earn cash back. The invite link on this page does not include a code, so there is nothing to type; just sign up through the link.

The invite page shows that the inviter sends you NT$50 as an invite reward. Under the official terms the new member must, within 180 days of registering: sign up with the invite link, code or email; complete orders totalling $800 or more at partner merchants through ShopBack; have that order's cash back turn "Confirmed"; and update bank account details for withdrawals. Only when all are met does the invitation count as successful; otherwise the referral reward becomes "Rejected". Actual conditions and amounts follow ShopBack's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 邀請頁與官方條款頁 2026-10-25 讀取。你貼的兩條 app.shopback.com 分享連結轉到同一位邀請人的邀請頁，頁面會顯示邀請人的名稱，本站不收錄。官方條款自己有兩個門檻：成功邀請的定義寫累積消費 $800 元，後文審核條款寫 $500 元，頁面沒有說明差異，本站採較高的 $800 元。條款也寫：2023/1/16 後註冊的朋友適用現行累積規則；取消或退換貨的訂單、0% 回饋商品與部分合作商家不計入；禁止多重帳號自我邀請、自動化或偽裝連結，以及在合作商家的官方社群平台張貼邀請連結。本站沒有註冊測試。
notes.en: The invite page and the official terms page were read on 2026-10-25. The two app.shopback.com share links provided lead to the same inviter's invite page, which shows the inviter's name; this site does not record it. The official terms contain two thresholds: the definition of a successful invitation says $800 of cumulative spend while a later review clause says $500, and the page does not explain the difference, so this site uses the higher $800. The terms also say: the current accumulation rule applies to friends who registered after 2023/1/16; cancelled or returned orders, 0% cash back items and some partner merchants do not count; multiple-account self-invitation, automation or disguised links, and posting the invite link on a partner merchant's official social media are prohibited. No sign-up was tested.

q.zh-TW: 用 ShopBack 邀請連結註冊可以拿到多少獎勵金？
q.en: How much reward do I get by signing up with a ShopBack invite link?

a.zh-TW: 2026-10-25 讀取的邀請頁顯示邀請人送你 NT$50 邀請獎勵金。官方條款沒有另列金額，而且要完成成功邀請的條件才會轉為已確認，所以實際以頁面與官方公告為準。
a.en: The invite page read on 2026-10-25 showed that the inviter sends you NT$50. The official terms list no amount, and it turns confirmed only after the successful-invitation conditions are met, so the page and official announcements prevail.

q.zh-TW: 獎勵金為什麼會變成「被拒絕」？

a.zh-TW: 條款列出的原因：自註冊日起 180 天內沒有完成全部條件；訂單取消或退換貨；消費屬於 0% 回饋商品或不計入的合作商家；多重帳號自我邀請；沒有透過邀請連結註冊，或不是用自己的裝置註冊。
a.en: Reasons named in the terms: not meeting every condition within 180 days of registering; cancelled or returned orders; spending on 0% cash back items or excluded partner merchants; self-invitation with multiple accounts; not registering through the invite link or not using your own device.
